title: GO lane ACTIVATED by Jordan ruling; first GO id allocated and the port spec given a real Status line
description: Jordan ruled 2026-08-14: GO lane ACTIVE (ED-IN-0185 Q6). Context and the finding that raised it: ED-IN-0183 M2 -- not restated. Before this the lane had next_free 1 with no ED ever allocated and no lane ledger, so its emptiness read as neglect rather than as a deliberate state. ONE CORRECTION TO ED-IN-0183 M2: it reports godot_architecture_specification.md:723 as 'a literal unfilled template line' sitting outside the STATUS_HEAD_LINES=80 window. Line 723 is inside a ```markdown FENCE -- it is template text for the per-document extraction worksheet, not the document's own Status. The real defect is that the spec carried NO Status line anywhere. Added at line 5, inside the window; :723 deliberately untouched. The spec is stamped STALE REFERENCE, not activated: it is dated 2026-04-11, predates the d+sigma model canonized 2026-05-15, and the governing spec remains godot_conversion_strategy_v1.md (PROPOSED). Activating a lane does not promote its stale documents. STILL BLOCKED, unchanged by activation: Gate-0 entry waits on ED-1051 (engine_clock), the strategy doc's 8-item register is unruled, and the port-seam audit stays deferred by the 2026-07-07 ruling with Gate-0 entry as its trigger. MEASURED-BY: grep -c 'ED-GO-' over registers/ reproduces the pre-state (0 allocations); awk over the spec reproduces the head-Status absence at any revision before this one.
falsifier: tests/valoria/test_single_status_line.py must still pass (the fenced :723 line must not be read as a second Status); references/id_reservations.yaml GO next_free reads 2; registers/editorial_ledger_go.jsonl exists and validate_ed_citations resolves ED-GO-0001.
